RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

This agreement is made between Stichting Grachtwonen (the landlord) and the tenant named in Annex A for the apartment at Keizersgracht 212-II, Amsterdam.

1. Term
The lease starts on 1 March 2026 and runs for an indefinite period. The first twelve months form a minimum term during which neither party may end the agreement, except as set out in article 9.

2. Rent
The basic monthly rent is EUR 1,650. Service charges for cleaning of common areas, garden maintenance and the elevator contract are EUR 85 per month and are settled once a year against actual costs. Rent and service charges are due in advance, no later than the first day of each calendar month, by bank transfer to the account stated in Annex B.

3. Annual rent increase
The landlord may raise the basic rent once a year on 1 July. The increase will not exceed the maximum percentage the government sets for the private sector that year. The tenant will be informed in writing at least two months before the increase takes effect.

4. Security deposit
Before receiving the keys, the tenant pays a security deposit equal to two months of basic rent (EUR 3,300). The landlord holds the deposit in a separate account. After the tenant leaves, the deposit is returned within fourteen days, minus any amounts needed to repair damage beyond normal wear and tear or to settle unpaid rent. The landlord provides an itemised statement of any deductions.

5. Use of the apartment
The apartment may only be used as a private residence for the tenant and members of the tenant's household. Subletting the whole apartment is not allowed. Renting out a room or the whole apartment through short-stay platforms is not allowed under any circumstances.

6. Pets
Small pets such as cats, birds and fish are allowed. Dogs are allowed only with written permission from the landlord, which will not be withheld without good reason. The tenant is liable for any damage caused by pets.

7. Maintenance and repairs
Minor repairs are the tenant's responsibility, including replacing light bulbs, bleeding radiators, unblocking drains and replacing tap washers. The landlord is responsible for major repairs, the central heating boiler, the roof, the facade and the window frames. The tenant reports defects to the landlord without delay through the service portal.

8. Alterations
The tenant may not make changes to the apartment that cannot be undone without significant cost, such as removing walls or replacing the kitchen, without prior written permission. Painting walls in light colours and hanging pictures is allowed. At the end of the lease the tenant restores changes made without permission.

9. Ending the lease
After the minimum term, the tenant may terminate the lease at any time with a notice period of one full calendar month. Notice must be given in writing or by registered email before the first day of the month. The landlord may only terminate on the grounds listed in the Civil Code, with a notice period of at least three months, extended by one month for each full year the tenant has lived in the apartment, up to a maximum of six months.

10. Inspection on departure
At the end of the lease the landlord and tenant carry out a joint inspection of the apartment. A pre-inspection takes place at least two weeks before the end date so the tenant can still repair any defects. The findings are recorded in a report signed by both parties.

11. Insurance
The tenant takes out contents insurance and third-party liability insurance. The landlord insures the building.

Signed in Amsterdam, 12 February 2026.

# Employee handbook — Northwind Robotics

Welcome to Northwind Robotics. This handbook explains how we work together. It does not replace your employment contract; where the two differ, your contract applies.

## Working hours and remote work

Our standard working week is 38 hours. Core hours are 10:00 to 15:00, when everyone should be reachable. Outside core hours you plan your own day together with your team.

You may work from home up to three days a week. Teams agree on at least one shared office day so people actually meet. If you want to work from another country for more than two weeks, ask HR first, because tax and insurance rules may apply.

## Vacation and leave

Full-time employees receive 27 vacation days per year, on top of public holidays. Part-time employees receive a proportional number. You can carry over at most five unused days to the next year; carried-over days expire on 1 July.

Request vacation in the HR portal at least four weeks in advance for periods longer than one week. Shorter periods can be requested two weeks ahead.

Parental leave, care leave and special leave (for example for a wedding or a funeral) follow the collective agreement. Ask HR which form applies to your situation.

## Sick leave

If you are ill, call your manager before 9:00 on the first day. Sending a chat message is not enough. Also register the sick report in the HR portal. If you are ill for longer than one week, the company doctor will contact you. Report your recovery to your manager and in the portal on the day you return.

## Expenses

Business expenses are reimbursed when you submit the receipt within 60 days through the expense app. Travel by public transport is reimbursed in full. If you use your own car for business trips, you receive EUR 0.23 per kilometre. Meals during a business trip are reimbursed up to EUR 35 per day. Alcohol is never reimbursed.

The home office allowance is EUR 2.40 per day worked from home and is paid with the monthly salary.

## Equipment and security

You receive a laptop and a phone. Use a password manager and turn on two-factor authentication for every work account. Report a lost or stolen device to the IT service desk within one hour, day or night, so it can be wiped remotely.

Do not install software from unknown sources. Personal use of the laptop is allowed within reason, but files on it belong to the company.

## Training and development

Every employee has a personal development budget of EUR 1,500 per year for courses, conferences and books. Unused budget does not carry over. Training that the company requires for your role is paid separately and does not count against your budget. Discuss your plans in your yearly development conversation with your manager.

## Performance and salary

We hold a development conversation in spring and a salary review in November. Salary increases take effect on 1 January. If you think your salary is out of line with the market, raise it with your manager or HR at any time.

## Leaving the company

The notice period for employees is one month, unless your contract says otherwise. Return your laptop, phone and access badge on your last working day. Remaining vacation days are paid out with your final salary.

BREWMASTER 3000 ESPRESSO MACHINE — USER MANUAL

Safety
Read all instructions before using the machine. Never immerse the machine, the cord or the plug in water. Place the machine on a stable, heat-resistant surface away from the edge of the counter. The steam wand and the brew group become very hot during use; do not touch them. Unplug the machine before cleaning and when it is not used for a long time.

First use
Rinse the water tank and fill it with fresh, cold water up to the MAX line. Insert the tank and switch the machine on with the power button on the side. The lights blink while the machine heats up, which takes about 25 seconds. Before making your first coffee, run two full tanks of water through the brew group without coffee to flush the system.

Making espresso
Grind 18 grams of coffee for a double shot. Distribute the grounds evenly in the filter basket and tamp firmly. Lock the portafilter into the brew group and press the double cup button. A good shot takes 25 to 30 seconds. If the coffee runs too fast, grind finer; if it drips slowly, grind coarser.

Steaming milk
Fill the milk jug one third with cold milk. Turn the steam dial and wait until the steam light stops blinking. Hold the wand just below the surface of the milk to add air, then lower it to heat the milk to about 60 degrees. Wipe the wand with a damp cloth and purge it briefly after every use so milk does not dry inside.

Cleaning and maintenance
Empty the drip tray and the coffee grounds container every day. Clean the filter basket and the shower screen once a week with warm water.

Descaling
The machine needs descaling when the orange calcium light comes on, or at least every three months. In areas with hard water, descale every six weeks. Use only the liquid Brewmaster descaler; vinegar damages the seals and voids the warranty. Fill the tank with the descaler and water to the descaling line, place a large bowl under the brew group and the steam wand, and hold the descale button for five seconds. The program takes about 30 minutes. Afterwards rinse the tank and run one full tank of clean water through the machine.

Troubleshooting
No water comes out: check that the tank is filled and inserted correctly, and descale the machine if the calcium light is on.
The coffee is not hot enough: preheat the cups with hot water and let the machine warm up for at least five minutes.
The pump is very loud: the tank is empty or not seated properly.
Water leaks under the machine: the drip tray is full or not pushed in all the way.
Error E4 means the temperature sensor failed; switch the machine off, wait ten minutes and switch it on again. If the error remains, contact service.

Warranty
The Brewmaster 3000 has a warranty of two years from the date of purchase. Keep your receipt. The warranty does not cover damage caused by not descaling, by using vinegar or other non-approved products, or by dropping the machine. To make a claim, contact the shop where you bought the machine or register at service.brewmaster.example.

Japan trip — April 2027 (Sam and Noor)

Flights
Outbound: KLM KL861, Amsterdam Schiphol to Tokyo Narita, departs Friday 2 April at 14:40, arrives Saturday 3 April at 10:05 local time. Booking reference QX7RT2.
Return: KLM KL862, Osaka Kansai to Amsterdam, departs Sunday 18 April at 11:30, arrives the same day at 17:15. Both flights include one checked bag of 23 kg each.

Japan Rail Pass
We bought a 14-day Japan Rail Pass. Activate it at the JR office in Narita airport on arrival day; bring both passports. The pass covers most Shinkansen trains except the fastest Nozomi services, so book Hikari trains between Tokyo and Kyoto.

Tokyo (3 to 8 April)
Hotel: Shibuya Stream Excel, five nights, check-in from 15:00. Breakfast is not included.
Plans: teamLab Planets on Sunday morning (tickets booked for 9:30), Tsukiji outer market, a day trip to Kamakura to see the Great Buddha, and dinner at Sushi Kanesaka on Tuesday at 19:00 (reservation under Noor's name, cancellation fee 100 percent within 48 hours).

Hakone (8 to 10 April)
Ryokan: Gora Kadan, two nights with dinner and breakfast included. The ryokan has a private onsen; tattoos must be covered in the public baths. Take the Hakone Free Pass for the ropeway and lake cruise.

Kyoto (10 to 15 April)
Hotel: Hotel Kanra, five nights. Cherry blossom season may be ending; walk the Philosopher's Path early in the morning to avoid crowds. Fushimi Inari before 8:00. Tea ceremony booked on 12 April at 14:00 in Gion.

Osaka (15 to 18 April)
Hotel: Cross Hotel Osaka, three nights. Day trip to Nara on the 16th to see the deer and Todai-ji. Street food in Dotonbori. Universal Studios is optional if the weather is bad.

Money and practical
Budget: about EUR 6,000 for two people excluding flights. Many small restaurants accept cash only, so withdraw yen at 7-Eleven ATMs. Get a Suica card on the phone for local trains and convenience stores. Travel insurance through Centraal Beheer, policy 88-23011, emergency number on the card.

POLISVOORWAARDEN INBOEDELVERZEKERING — VERZEKERAAR DE HAVEN

Artikel 1 Wat is verzekerd
Deze verzekering dekt schade aan uw inboedel: alle roerende zaken die tot uw particuliere huishouding behoren, zoals meubels, kleding, elektronica, sieraden en fietsen. Sieraden zijn verzekerd tot maximaal EUR 6.000 per gebeurtenis. Geld en cheques zijn verzekerd tot EUR 1.250.

Artikel 2 Welke gebeurtenissen zijn gedekt
Wij vergoeden schade door brand, ontploffing, blikseminslag, storm, inbraak en diefstal, waterschade door een plotseling gesprongen leiding, en vandalisme na inbraak. Schade door grondwater of door water dat langzaam naar binnen sijpelt is niet verzekerd.

Artikel 3 Diefstal van fietsen
Een fiets is alleen verzekerd tegen diefstal als hij op slot stond met een ART-gekeurd slot met minimaal twee sterren. U moet de originele sleutels kunnen inleveren en aangifte doen bij de politie. Elektrische fietsen zijn verzekerd tot EUR 3.500.

Artikel 4 Eigen risico
Voor iedere schade geldt een eigen risico van EUR 100. Bij stormschade geldt geen eigen risico.

Artikel 5 Wat moet u doen bij schade
Meld schade zo snel mogelijk, maar uiterlijk binnen veertien dagen, via de app of op dehaven.example/schade. Bij inbraak, diefstal en vandalisme doet u eerst aangifte bij de politie. Bewaar beschadigde spullen tot wij ze hebben gezien en maak foto's. Wij kunnen een expert sturen om de schade te beoordelen.

Artikel 6 Uitkering
Wij vergoeden de nieuwwaarde van spullen die niet ouder zijn dan twee jaar. Voor oudere spullen vergoeden wij de dagwaarde. Wij betalen binnen tien werkdagen nadat wij alle benodigde gegevens hebben ontvangen.

Artikel 7 Opzeggen
U kunt de verzekering na het eerste jaar op ieder moment opzeggen met een opzegtermijn van een maand. Opzeggen kan via Mijn De Haven of per brief. Bij een verhuizing past u het adres aan in Mijn De Haven; de premie kan dan veranderen.

Artikel 8 Premie
De premie betaalt u per maand via automatische incasso. Als u de premie niet op tijd betaalt, sturen wij een herinnering. Betaalt u daarna nog steeds niet, dan schorten wij de dekking op na veertien dagen.

# Kitchen renovation — meeting with contractor (22 September 2026)

Present: Sam, Noor, Pieter (Bouwbedrijf Van Dijk), Elif (kitchen designer)

## Decisions

- We go with the oak fronts and the white composite worktop. The darker stone was beautiful but costs EUR 2,400 more.
- The gas connection will be removed; we switch to an induction hob. Pieter arranges the disconnection with the grid operator, which takes about six weeks.
- The wall between the kitchen and the dining room stays. Removing it would need a steel beam and a structural engineer, which does not fit the budget.

## Budget

The total quote is EUR 31,500 including VAT: EUR 18,900 for the kitchen itself, EUR 8,200 for installation and plumbing, EUR 2,600 for electrical work, and EUR 1,800 for tiling. We pay 30 percent at signing, 50 percent when the kitchen is delivered and the remaining 20 percent after completion.

## Planning

Demolition starts on Monday 9 November. The kitchen is delivered in week 47 and installation takes about two weeks. We should be able to cook again before Christmas. During the work we use a temporary kitchen in the garage with a microwave and a two-plate induction cooker.

## Open questions

- Elif sends a revised drawing with the extra drawer cabinet by Friday.
- Pieter checks whether the existing drain can stay in place for the sink on the island.
- Noor asks the neighbours whether the skip can stand in front of their house for one week.

## Action items

- Sam: sign the quote and pay the first instalment before 1 October.
- Noor: choose the tiles for the back wall at the showroom in Utrecht.
- Pieter: apply for the parking permit for the skip.
